findings.issue: Malformed persisted BLOB binding/request JSON escapes the typed read-error boundary.
findings.evidence: The reader passes binding_json/request_json directly to _read. SQLite TEXT affinity permits BLOB values; _read calls digest(raw), which calls raw.encode and raises AttributeError for bytes before hash validation. Neither reader exception translation includes AttributeError. This produces an untyped corruption failure instead of TradingFeedbackReadError.
findings.minimal_fix: Require expected serialized text/hash types locally before _read, preferably using bounded SQL type/length predicates before transfer. Preserve exact canonical/hash validation and do not broadly suppress programming failures.
findings.minimal_regression: Corrupt a genuine owned run binding or claimed request JSON to SQLite BLOB while restoring the exact original immutable trigger/schema. Require TradingFeedbackReadError, unchanged generations/history and no reader write attempt.

static_assessment: The module opens protected existing paths mode=ro, live-WAL-aware, query_onlyON/trusted_schemaOFF. Expected schema construction/migration occurs only in memory.

Same-file canonical/dispatch paths use one connection/transaction; separate connections capture data_version before and after the read snapshots. File identity, elapsed deadline, per-value SQLite length and aggregate row/byte budgets provide conservative refusal rather than truncation.

Existing PaperRuntimeJournal recovery receives only the real read-only connection through non-opening wrappers; no writer factory, current permission evaluation, provider request, report generation or owner attachment is added.
